signal.riskRule:
Active session rules:
• After 1 same-day loss on any index, fresh signals switch to No Trade across all indices.
• After 2 resolved trades in a day across all indices combined, fresh trade publication stops.
• After any stop-loss, the engine waits 60 minutes before another fresh entry.
• Losses on both call and put side in the same day halt all fresh signals (range-day protection).
• Midday entries (11:00 AM-1:30 PM IST) require 85%+ conviction on a trend day; otherwise they stay No Trade.
• No fresh entry when intraday ATR is under 0.11% of price; the move is too small to be worth the risk.
Trade management:
• Prefer a retest of the breakout level; if the trend runs away without pulling back, take a momentum entry rather than miss it (stop stays below the level).
• Book half at +1R and trail the rest; reduce time in trade first.
• Only publish when the move has room to run (minimum 2.2R structural target).
• If it does not move soon, let it go. Limit risk to 1-2% of capital per trade.
signal.timingRule: Preferred windows: 9:30-11:00 AM and 1:30-2:30 PM IST. Avoid low-liquidity midday conditions from 12:00-1:00 PM.
signal.avoidRule: Avoid sideways candles, major news spikes, and impulsive re-entry after losses. Staying out is acceptable when conditions are unclear.
